manifest.description: Computes a column from other columns with a template expression. Templates follow Data Designer's sandbox rules: no {% set %}, {% include %}, {% import %}, {% macro %}, {% extends %} or {% block %}; no loop inside a loop and no recursive loop; no {{ self }}; at most 600 template nodes and nesting depth 10; filters only from: abs, capitalize, escape, first, float, forceescape, int, items, last, length, list, lower, max, min, random, replace, reverse, round, sort, string, title, trim, truncate, unique, upper, urlencode, jsonpath. A template sees the content columns and any other non-system column it names (a metadata column or an earlier dd_* step's output); _dw_* columns are never visible. dataworks_validate_operator_params checks all of this and names the rule that fails. A row whose expression renders empty is dropped with reason dd.empty_render (an intended skip); dd.render_error and dd.type_cast_error mark real failures. A template sees each column as the type it was stored with: text stays text ("9" is never 9, "[ ]" never a list, JSON text never an object), and the output is stored as its dtype (str text, int int64, float float64, bool boolean); a value of another type fails the step with dtype_violation.
manifest.name: dd_expression

dtype.description: Data type for expression result: 'int', 'float', 'str', or 'bool'

expr.description: Jinja2 expression to compute the column value from other columns
